visualCharacteristics.layout: Flex wrap, space-around, align-content centre; items margin 20px auto; >= 768px list margin-top 50px and items 30% wide; stacked on mobile.
visualCharacteristics.button: Outline button: background #007acb, 1px solid #fff, colour #fff, 200px wide, padding 13px 20px, 13.5px/500, radius 2px, shadow 0 8px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.1), wraps long labels; hover background #0065a7.
visualCharacteristics.caption: p 14px/1.65 margin 14px 0, white, centred.
visualCharacteristics.section: Sits in a 'blue, centered' section that supplies the band, h2 and intro paragraph; the section Anchor ID get-in-touch is the hero CTA target.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contact options: a button per channel with a short caption.

contentPattern.structure: One item per row; the first paragraph holding only a link (plain, bold/italic or p.button-container > a.button) is the button, other paragraphs are captions.

usage: mybeckman.in /service 'Get in Touch' contact band (section style 'blue, centered').
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-4 call-to-action buttons with captions on a blue mybeckman.in band (tel:/mailto:/page links).
